content: 7shifts, a restaurant vertical product: the primary qualification unit is position, e.g. server, cook, bartender, manager, rather than skill tag; restaurants model qualification as disjoint job-role membership per shift-slot. Labor cost reporting is broken down by position. Multi-position staff, e.g. a server-bartender, are supported by assigning a person to more than one position, the restaurant-world equivalent of a person carrying two tags.
